name: CATALYST_SOURCE_RELEVANCE_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: CATALYST_SOURCE_RELEVANCE_20261107 — LQ-20261107-131. A search result is a catalyst only
when the page's own text names the issuer (whole-word ticker or company name, the read-side
matcher reused) AND the page is current (dated within 14 days; an undated page counts only when
it names the COMPANY). Measured 2026-11-07 on the live 2026-11-06 run: CIIT was 'news_momentum
high 0.6' on a 688-day-old Wikinews page, a bank login page and a certification page; VSA on a
car warning-light article; DFH 'high 0.6' on a Forbes page 298 days old and a stock chart. The
same file pins the survivors (PMN 8 days, DXCM, CDT, XRPN, Wendy's via the apostrophe fix) so a
future tightening cannot quietly blind the lane. Registered because a new pytest file that no
gate names is not run by CI (check_test_coverage --fail-on-new).
